title: One catalogue and one total resolver behind both display surfaces
outcome: The same failure produces the same sentence whichever surface shows it, and an unrecognised failure produces a safe generic one rather than whatever the server happened to send.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/api/error-messages.ts is the only module in the repository holding a string a user reads after a request fails. The five inline toast titles and the two existing reason messages move into it, and so does team-switcher's hand-written failure toast, which today writes its own copy in a catch and reaches no resolver — a fourth display path the design did not account for until the inventory found it.

Every entry has the same shape, { title, description }. Keys are a reason constant or one of four class-level constants, and the class-level constants are typed such that a mistyped key fails to compile rather than falling through to UNKNOWN.
resolveErrorDisplay(error: unknown) returns ErrorMessage for every input, including a non-ApiClientError and a 401. No null, no sentinel, no branch at any call site.

showErrorToast resolves and wraps; the three AlertDialog sites resolve and render the description. getErrorMessage is gone as a name, and its docstring's claim about invitation items — which use the toast path — goes with it.

A test feeds one ApiClientError through both surfaces and asserts an identical description. Two paths disagreeing about the same failure is the defect this slice removes, so it needs a direct assertion rather than two separate per-surface tests.
A test asserts an unrecognised reason renders the UNKNOWN entry. The branch stays reachable after S05 because the client-invented TIMEOUT and NETWORK_ERROR belong to no enum.

swr-provider carries a comment recording that its redirect latch is released by full page load, and that full page load is guaranteed only because sign-in is OAuth-only. No behaviour change: removing the 401 early return already restores a message for every 401.

use-editing-guard's unsaved-edit notice stays where it is, with a comment recording why: the catalogue is keyed by a reason the server supplies, and this notice has no key. It is the app reporting its own state with no request behind it, so a lookup table would add indirection that resolves to one constant. The boundary belongs in the code that would otherwise be moved by mistake.
